stories.summary: MHA said Singapore got "limited information or assistance" from the US despite repeated requests to secure Super Micro's cooperation in its AI-chip probe, and clarified its investigation into Alice Huang was not about espionage.
stories.title: Singapore says US offered limited help in its probe of AI chip deals
stories.why: It publicly strains US–Singapore cooperation just as the Nvidia scandal puts Singapore's chip-trade controls under scrutiny.

stories.summary: Underlying first-half net profit rose 10% to S$1.49 billion and Singtel raised its FY2027 operating-earnings outlook to mid-to-high single-digit growth; shares rose as much as 3%, the biggest intraday gain since mid-August.
stories.title: Singtel posts biggest gain since Aug on H1 profit rise
stories.why: Growth at NCS, data centres and Optus is carrying Singapore's largest telco, and the guidance upgrade signals confidence in its core businesses.

stories.summary: LTA will roll out a new intelligent road video platform from 2028 that uses video analytics to detect hazards, illegal parking and wrong-way vehicles and automatically alert the authorities; the tender is expected to be awarded in Q2 2027.
stories.title: LTA upgrades road video platform to detect incidents
stories.why: It is the next step in AI-driven traffic management on Singapore's roads, consolidating CCTV from expressways, tunnels and arterial roads.

stories.summary: Microsoft said it is seeing "broad recovery and stability" after a global outage hit Outlook, Teams and Copilot in 74 countries, apologising and ruling out a cyberattack or AI cause; the fault came from an earlier network capacity upgrade.
stories.title: Microsoft sees 'broad recovery' after major outage
stories.why: The outage disrupted governments, schools and businesses worldwide, including in Singapore, and exposed how dependent daily work is on one cloud provider.

stories.summary: Starship Flight 15 lifted off from Texas and its upper stage reached orbit and deployed 26 Starlink V3 satellites, but the Super Heavy booster catch was aborted and the booster splashed down in the Gulf of Mexico; the ship's own first-ever tower catch is planned for Saturday afternoon.
stories.title: SpaceX launches 15th Starship flight, aborts booster catch
stories.why: It is the most ambitious reusability test yet — a fully recovered orbital rocket would sharply cut launch costs for Moon and Mars plans.

stories.summary: Nasdaq told Singularity Future Technology (SGLY) its shares had traded below US$1 for 30 straight business days, breaching listing rules; with a reverse split in the past year it gets no 180-day grace period, and trading could be suspended on 19 Nov if it does not appeal by 17 Nov.
stories.title: Singularity Future Technology received notice of delisting
stories.why: A small-cap casualty of the week's tech sell-off, showing the rout is reaching beyond the big names.

stories.summary: The S&P 500 fell 0.4% to 7,561.67 and the Nasdaq lost 0.9% on Friday as Nvidia's troubles pressured tech, while the Dow edged up 0.1%; October PPI was softer than expected but the annual rate hit 6.5%, keeping December rate-hike bets alive.
stories.title: US stocks: Nasdaq ends lower as Nvidia uncertainty weighs on tech shares
stories.why: The Nvidia fallout and sticky US inflation are driving both the tech sell-off and the Fed's likely December hike.

stories.summary: Brent settled at US$95.84 and WTI at US$88.56 on Friday, both down about 2.5% for the week, as an IEA report pointed to a growing global surplus and Washington's Iran blockade lowered fears of renewed large-scale fighting, despite Houthi attacks on Saudi energy sites.
stories.title: Oil prices set for second straight weekly drop on signs of growing supply surplus
stories.why: Oil now hinges on the supply glut versus war-risk disruption in the Gulf — two forces pulling prices in opposite directions.

stories.summary: Nvidia's market value dropped below US$4 trillion on Friday, putting it on pace for its largest weekly market-cap loss on record after shedding roughly US$650 billion in a week rattled by Jensen Huang's resignation.
stories.title: Nvidia braces for biggest weekly market cap decline on record
stories.why: The chipmaker at the heart of the AI boom has lost about a third of its value in weeks, and the sell-off is dragging global tech stocks with it.

stories.summary: Qatar and Türkiye signed a mutual defence agreement in Istanbul pledging a unified stance against any external armed attack on either party, alongside wider military cooperation, joint exercises and defence-industry partnerships.
stories.title: Qatar and Türkiye sign mutual defence agreement at Istanbul summit
stories.why: It deepens a Gulf defence bloc amid the US–Israel war on Iran, following the Türkiye–Pakistan–Saudi pact signed in August.

stories.summary: Ukraine fired almost 1,200 drones at Russian targets overnight in one of its biggest aerial attacks of the war, hitting a Volgograd oil refinery, as US and Russian negotiators widened peace talks to cover Europe's post-Cold War security arrangements.
stories.title: Ukraine launches nearly 1,200 drones at Russia ahead of US-led European security talks
stories.why: The scale of the strike — and Zelenskyy's complaints about Starlink speed limits on Ukrainian drones — shows how central drones and satellite links have become to the war.

stories.summary: The Indian and Malaysian armies will hold Exercise Harimau Shakti 2026 from 18 to 30 November, focused on interoperability, operational synergy and mutual trust.
stories.title: Indian and Malaysian Army to begin joint exercise Harimau Shakti 2026
stories.why: It is part of a steady build-up of bilateral military ties in the region, following the fifth edition in Rajasthan last December.

stories.summary: Papua New Guinea's government is developing a national AI strategy to address misinformation and AI-generated content, focusing on transparency, accountability and safeguards against misuse, according to DICT deputy secretary Flierl Shongol.
stories.title: PNG developing AI strategy to tackle misinformation
stories.why: It is one of the first Pacific governments to frame AI-generated misinformation as a national policy problem ahead of its 2027 elections.

tldr: Singapore: MHA says the US gave "limited help" in its probe into Alice Huang and AI-chip deals.
Technology: Microsoft reports "broad recovery" after the global outage that hit Outlook and Teams.
Finance & global markets: US stocks ended lower on Friday as Nvidia uncertainty weighed on tech shares.
Defence & military developments: Qatar and Türkiye signed a mutual defence agreement in Istanbul.
Information warfare & Information Operations: Papua New Guinea is developing a national AI strategy to tackle misinformation.
